## XPG GAMMIX S70 BLADE PCIe Gen4x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

Enjoy next-gen performance with the XPG GAMMIX S70 BLADE PCIe Gen4x4 M.2 2280 solid state drive (SSD). Sporting the latest PCIe Gen4x4 interface and a host of other capabilities, this SSD is capable of reaching blazing-fast read/write speeds of up to 7,400/6,800MB per second.

## Features Ordering Information

| ● R/W speed up to 7,400/6,800MB/s | for PC/laptop Capacity | Model Number | EAN Code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ● Ultra-fast PCIe Gen4 x4 interface | 8000GB | AGAMMIXS70B-8000G-CS | 4711085945525 |
| ● Compliant with NVMe 1.4 | 4TB | AGAMMIXS70B-4T-CS | 4711085937858 |
| ● Work with PS5 | 2TB | AGAMMIXS70B-2T-CS | 4711085933072 |
| | 1TB | AGAMMIXS70B-1T-CS | 4711085933065 |
| ● High-temperature resistant aluminum heat | sink 512GB | AGAMMIXS70B-512G-CS | 4711085936219 |

which is able to reduce temperatures by up to 20%

● Capacity up to 8TB ● SLC Caching and DRAM cache buffer ● Advanced LDPC ECC Technology ● E2E Data Protection and RAID Engine ● AES 256-bit encryption support ● Compact M.2 2280 form factor – ideal for gaming

and high-end desktops www.xpg.com

## Specifications

● Capacities: 512GB / 1TB(1024GB) / 2TB(2048GB) / ● Shock Resistance: 1500G/0.5ms

| 4TB(4096GB) / 8TB(8000GB) | ● Weight: |
| --- | --- |
| ● NAND Flash: 3D NAND | 10g / 0.35oz (with heat sink) |
| ● Interface: PCIe Gen4 x4 | 7g / 0.24oz (without heat sink) |
| ● Form Factor: M.2 2280 | ● Dimensions (L x W x T): |
| ● Controller: Innogrit IG5236 | 80 x 22 x 4.3mm (with heatsink) |
| ● Sequential read/write (Max.): | 80 x 22 x 3.3mm (without heatsink) |
| Up to 7,400/6,800MB/s (PC/laptop) | ● Terabytes Written (TBW)(Max. capacity): 5920TB |
| ● 4K random read/write IOPS (Max.): 750K/750K | ● MTBF: 2,000,000 hours |
| ● Operating Temperature: 0°C~70°C | ● Warranty: 5-year limited |
| ● Storage Temperature: -40°C~85°C | ● Certifications: CE, FCC, BSMI, KC, Morocco, EAC, RCM, |
| | |

UKCA, RoHS

## Performance

| Capacity | Sequential Performance (Up to) Read (MB/s) | 1 Write (MB/s) | 4K Random Read (IOPS) | 2 (Up to) Write (IOPS) | 3 TBW |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 512GB | 7,200 | 2,600 | 425K | 510K | 370TB |
| 1TB | 7,400 | 5,500 | 740K | 740K | 740TB |
| 2TB | 7,400 | 6,800 | 750K | 750K | 1480TB |
| 4TB | 7,400 | 6,600 | 750K | 750K | 2960TB |
| 8000GB | 7,300 | 6,300 | 750K | 650K | 5920TB |

1M/B: MSI X570 GAMING PLUS, CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor @ 3.60GHZ 
2Performance may vary based on SSD capacity, hardware test platform, test software, operating system and other system variables 
3The value is the minimum amount of terabyte written that could be reached.
